## Skill and host

Which skill, agent application, and version or commit?

## Request and observed behavior

What did you ask? What happened? What did you expect?

## Minimal example

Use a short synthetic or appropriately licensed source/target excerpt. Please omit personal paths, credentials, private logs, full books, and complete translations.

## Evidence and limits

What supports the proposed correction? Is it a demonstrated error, an uncertain reading, or a stylistic preference?
